evidence: TiO2 was deposited by Atomic Layer Deposition (Savannah 100 of the Cambridge Nanotech Inc., MA), using TDMAT (tetrakis(dimethylamido)titanium), Sigma–Aldrich, (Germany) as titanium source and milliQ water as oxygen source. The deposition temperature and pressure were, respectively, 90 /C176C and 0.5 Torr. The processing cycle consisted of a TDMAT pulse of 0.1 s, a 10 s of purge time, a 0.1 s pulse of water vapour and 10 s of purge time.
